'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Thomas McGee DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas McGee]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time|V1-D-imperialentanglements.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Tom McGee
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
